_note: Upgrades (passives) sold in the Hardening shop. load is what the upgrade uses of the upgrade load (2 on Day 1, 2N on Day N). price is in Security Points. The icon is assets/upgrades/icon_<id>.png. The ids match the defenses in the Response phase. clues are the ids of the Investigation clues the upgrade answers: when the player found one, the Upgrade Editor recommends the upgrade.
